They give me a feeling of being available to life.

47: Keep the invitation open.; Photographs from Spencer Gray’s personal archive, including portraits of Spencer and friends. Individual camera credits are not established; people remain unnamed. The narrative adapts Spencer’s account of a beautiful period of trying new things, staying open to new experiences, and meeting some of his favorite humans. First-person passages are editorial adaptations, not verbatim diary entries. The selected archive centers on 2017–2018. Festival names follow the source albums; metadata may record a save or import rather than the moment pictured. The sequence is a memory, not a strict itinerary.
